newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-FORMER POLISH NATIONAL COACH JOINS CHINA TE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER POLISH NATIONAL COACH JOINS CHINA TE.

text.p: Andrej Strejlau, former head coach for the Polish national soccer team, has taken over China's Shanghai Shenhua team, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

Strejlau, 57, who took over China's number two team on Tuesday, trained the Polish national eleven for 54 international matches from 1989 to 1993 and had been an advisor to Shenhua since April, Xinhua said.
He replaces Shanghai Shenhua's Bulgarian coach, who resigned on Sunday after the team was held to a 0-0 draw by Guangzhou Apollo in a home match.
Shanghai Shenhua, which won China's professional soccer league in 1995, now lies in second place behind Dalian Wanda in the 12-team league.
